notes: Minimal patch: adds missing else clause in stage_contact_update_from_memory to return a proposal dict when _should_auto_apply returns False. This prevents silent None return and ensures the caller receives a structured proposal result. No other files touched.
patch_text:
--- a/backend/services/contact_manager.py
+++ b/backend/services/contact_manager.py
@@ -L +L @@
     if _should_auto_apply_contact_memory_update(
         memory=memory,
         match_mode=match_mode,
         metadata=metadata,
         proposal_payload=proposal_payload,
     ):
         return _apply_contact_memory_update_directly(
             db_session,
             target_contact=target_contact,
             proposal_payload=proposal_payload,
         )
+    else:
+        return {
+            "status": "proposed",
+            "reason": "requires_review",
+            "proposals_staged": 1,
+            "proposal_payload": proposal_payload,
+            "target_contact_id": target_contact.id,
+        }
risk_list: Low: Adding else clause changes return value from None to dict for non-auto-applied cases; callers must handle dict (existing handle_memory_write already does).
Low: proposal_payload and target_contact_id are new keys in the return dict; no existing code depends on their absence.
